raw_response:
I will still farm the way I know works here. I will not turn everything upside down. On my 8 mu, I will keep most land in wheat-maize because that is the steady road for food and cash, and I will leave a smaller piece for cotton. Last year, when wheat got enough base fertilizer and two or three waters, it held yield better. Maize after wheat is fast work, so I will keep that land together and sow right after harvest. Cotton takes more watching and more spraying, so I will not put too much area into it. I always look at what the good households around me do. If I cut fertilizer too hard and the crop turns yellow, that loss is bigger than wasting a bit of fertilizer, so I will feed a little on the safe side. I have well water, so I will use that when the land turns dry instead of waiting too long. For wheat and maize, I will stay close to last year’s habit. For cotton, I will keep only 3 mu because it needs more labor and medicine.
